newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-CHAMPION THROUGH BUT STUER-LAURIDSEN OUT.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-CHAMPION THROUGH BUT STUER-LAURIDSEN OUT.

text.p: Olympic champion Poul-Erik Hoyer-Larsen swept into the second round of the All England badminton championships on Tuesday but Danish compatriot Thomas Stuer-Lauridsen, seeded joint fifth, bowed out at the first hurdle.

Hoyer-Larsen, the top seed and defending champion,, beat Dutchman Gerben Bruystens 15-8 15-2 with the minimum of fuss, but Stuer-Lauridsen, a bronze medallist at the 1992 Olympics, went out to Luo Yigang, the Chinese winning 15-11 15-11.
Number two seed Rashid Sidek of Malaysia overcame Soren Nielsen of Denmark 15-4 15-10 but there was disappointment for another seasoned campaigner.
Indonesia's Ardy Wiranata, a former champion but unseeded this year, lost in straight games to Dong Jiong of China 15-9 18-15.
